fragments.summary: AUZiX package repository deploy and stripped ISO proof are now one BKC-visible lane with Ollama receipt review and classic root paths invalid by default.
facts: The AUZiX package repository is generated from strict-root package receipts by scripts/build-auzix-package-repo.sh.
Publishing the repository is a separate gated stage using scripts/publish-auzix-package-repo.sh.
The stripped ISO proof requires strict-root audit with AUZIX_LEGACY_POLICY=invalid.
Classic top-level paths may return only as explicit break-fix compatibility debt with path, owner, reason, and removal condition.
Ollama receives receipts only and selects the smallest next fix; it does not receive secrets or directly mutate lab state.
VM135 install validation remains gated because it may consume or reset the disposable AUZiX proof VM.
next_steps: Run the safe first pass against the existing strict root and package receipts.
Add missing source catalog entries for OCI and Flatpak package queues before enabling package builds.
Remove or quarantine compatibility links, then rerun strict-root audit under invalid legacy policy.
Build a stripped install ISO only after package repo and strict-root gates are understood.
